text:
Asking rents in Wuppertal stand at a median of 9.00 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.2% on the year and +27.2% over five years. That ranks Wuppertal #33 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 48% above the 2022 average contract rent of 6.10 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 540 € a month in cold rent, 12.8% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 35 days and 17% are gone within a week; with 2.3% market-active vacancy and +1.4% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 9.47 €/m² (+5.2%), with an 80% range of 9.22 to 9.67 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
